problem: `judge` accepts the same tile index twice and never checks the length of `chosen`: in «За буквами» with decoys, taps [0,1,0,1] pass «мама» and earn XP.
fix: Return `undefined` when `chosen` repeats an index or (for `tiles`) its length differs from `expected.length`.

problem: Confirm dialogs fire the write (`mutate` / `void write()`) and resolve at once: the dialog closes before the write, a refusal never shows in it, double submit is not blocked.
fix: `PendingWrite.run` returns a Promise (`mutateAsync` / `return write(...)`); `onConfirm` awaits it. See R80 for the shared `PendingWrite`.

problem: `heldBatch` locks the batch row FOR UPDATE, then takes the Edition advisory lock; `write` takes the advisory lock first, then its FK insert needs KEY SHARE on the same row: deadlock between write and review/rollback.
fix: Take the advisory lock before the batch row lock in `heldBatch`, same order as `heldVersion`.

problem: Any generator throw (non-zero exit, bad `results.json`, missing mp3) rejects the run before `markFailures`; the same Words are picked again, so one bad Word blocks the job (and the remaining Editions).
fix: Catch per batch, mark those Words failed, carry on.

problem: `visitStarted` lives in each composition; after any `composition.reopen()` (switches, sync, content patch) `sessionEnded` finds no start and sends nothing.
fix: Keep the Visit start in the shell, or carry it across reopen.

problem: `WordDefinition` is a plain Text, so the clamped «Суть» tab gets no line reports from it; the whole-lines cut then shows nothing (cut 0) or slices a line (ADR 0091).
While Editions load or fail, «Вимкнути зараз» sends `editionId: undefined`, which means kill in every Edition.
fix: Take the scope from `search.edition`, or disable the button until `editionsQuery.isSuccess`.

problem: With eveningNotification on, slots are capped by count over all times before filtering to earliest+latest time; with 5+ reminder times the plan covers fewer than 14 days and OS slots stay free (3-4 times are fine).
fix: Filter slots to the earliest/latest times before the count cap.

problem: Every `freezeUsed` event carries the same `freezesHeld` (the count after all the day's freezes); two freezes from 2 report 0 and 0, against analytics.ts:42.
Extra Definitions in the history tab are numbered from 1, while WordCard and IdiomCard number them from 2: a second «1.».
`inert` without `accessibilityState.disabled`: VoiceOver still announces answered vowels as active.
`voice` is spread on the inner Text, not on PressedTile's Pressable, so the Ukrainian label is read in the system language.
The Quick Question tag shows `asked.label`, but VoiceOver reads the hidden `title` (label-in-name mismatch).
Fixed `height: 50` and no font cap on the TextInput: large Dynamic Type clips the query.
A late `isReduceMotionEnabled()` promise overwrites a newer value from the change event.
fix: Ignore the promise once an event has arrived.

problem: Reduce Motion reads `false` until the system answers, so the full fly-in starts even with Reduce Motion on.
`answer` reads a stale `phase` closure: a double tap records the same Word twice / loses an answer.
`openedClosed` is frozen at mount and the hero has no key: on a new day the hero shows no animation.
`Math.max(...[])` is -Infinity when `lines` is empty, so the scale becomes -0 and the line disappears.
With `onLogo` the logo is a button with no `header` role, so the screen title is not announced as a heading.
fix: Keep the heading separate from the button.

problem: inactive→active reports `return`: a second `sessionStarted` without `sessionEnded`, an extra resume and sync.
The wordTabs branch drops page scroll also for the red Self-check Word of the Day card (not a fixed frame): a tall card is cut off.
fix: Keep `PagerScrollView` for cards that are not a fixed frame.

problem: Category feed still nests the tabbed card in the page `PagerScrollView` (ADR 0113: the page never scrolls); inner and outer scroll share `scrolls[index]`.
fix: Use the same fixed frame as Feed/Entry.

problem: `wordOfTheDayLanding` is cleared only when Feed finds the card; if it is absent, every Dashboard return jumps to /feed.
fix: Clear the landing whether or not the card is found.

problem: A failed read only logs; the screen stays loading forever.
fix: Use `useCompositionRead` and its failed state (see R77).

problem: After `await silence()` there is no `latestTap !== tap` check (the recording path has it at :128): two fast taps both speak.
`await recordingOf(id)` is uncaught; a rejection escapes through `void pronunciation.toggle`.
fix: try/catch and fall back to the device voice.

problem: Stored `line` is not keyed by `entryId`: a new Entry shows the old Entry's counters until its read lands.
fix: Store `{entryId, line}` and return it only on a match.

problem: Override re-import re-inserts Words with `needsNewRecording: false` and never calls `retireRecordings`, so changed Words keep old Recordings.
fix: Compare stored text on import and retire Recordings of changed Words.

problem: The file is put in the Media Store before its row is saved; `deleteRetired` can delete the same key in between and the save revives a row with no file.
fix: Save row and file under the Edition lock, or skip keys of live rows in the sweep.

problem: `signInWith` is check-then-create without a transaction: two first sign-ins with one email hit the `accounts.email` unique index → 500; no unique (provider, account id) index.
fix: One transaction with `on conflict`; add the unique index.

problem: The stale check sits after `await found`, so concurrent reads of a stale key each fetch.
fix: Decide fresh/stale on the kept `fetchedAt` synchronously and set the new promise before any await.

problem: `execFile` has no timeout; a hung generator outlives the lease.
`resolveFlag` reads all flags of every Edition and writes outside a transaction with no lock.
fix: Filter by id in SQL inside a transaction with a row/advisory lock.

problem: Activity average divides by 7 whatever `before.length` is.
fix: Divide by the number of days in range that exist for the Edition.

problem: The mixed-script check covers only Words, Corrections and Idioms; Tips (incl. `exceptions`) and Synonym Rows are never checked, so a Latin «i» ships.
fix: Run the mixed-script rule over all five Entry kinds.

problem: `String.fromCodePoint` throws RangeError on `�`; the backend loop has no catch, so one bad page stops the whole check.
fix: Skip code points over 0x10FFFF (keep the entity text).

problem: Outputs use strict schemas against ADR 0031: Patch/Snapshot embed `z.strictObject` record schemas (a validating client refuses a Patch once a record gains a field); admin analytics/counters outputs call `.strict()`.
fix: Use non-strict output variants of the record schemas; drop `.strict()` on outputs.

problem: A new property under `additionalProperties: false` is never reported (only promised properties are walked).
fix: Report added properties of a strict output object.

problem: `checkNewSynonymRows` replaces `synonymRows` with the drafts instead of appending; other kinds append.
One malformed row makes `Schema.parse` throw for the whole `getEntries` batch of all kinds.
fix: Document fail-fast in the port, or `safeParse` per record.

problem: The STALE branch re-reads the record inside `catch`; if that read fails, the rejection is swallowed by `void write()`.
fix: try/catch the re-read and fall back to `setErrors([refusalText(e)])`.

problem: Load errors are never shown: failed queries render as empty lists, or the matrix stays not ready.
fix: Expose `isError` and render a «Не вдалося» notice like quality.tsx.

problem: `spawn('maestro')` has no `error` listener: ENOENT throws, `finally` is skipped, `/tmp/slovo-maestro.lock` stays, every later Maestro run waits forever.
`curl -sSL` without `--fail`: a 404/5xx page is parsed as content and the script exits 0.
`Math.max(0, findIndex(...final))` silently stops on card 0 when `final` is missing.
`beatsFor(8)` / `stopFrameLength` are fixed at 8 cards while `changesFor(cards.length)` uses the real count. Latent: both episodes have 8 cards today.
fix: Throw when `cards.length !== 8`, or compute beats per episode.

problem: The `measureLayout` callback can re-report lines after cleanup removed its id, so stale lines from a bigger size step stay in `byId`. Only if the callback is async (Fabric calls it sync).
fix: Guard with a cancelled flag in the effect.

problem: With tabs the details are a fixed View (deliberate, ADR 0091/0113); at XL font the tab bar and «Детальніше» may be pushed off-screen. Needs a device check.
fix: Let the head scroll, or cap it.

problem: The Dashboard date is read with `todayDate(deviceClock)` at render; after midnight the header may show yesterday (a day-turn re-render probably hides it).
fix: Take `today` from a subscribed source, as `useFeed` does.

problem: `analytics.track` is awaited inside `inTurn` on the final solve, so later `play`/`keep` wait on a network round trip; game.ts uses `void`.
`refreshLinks` re-reads and rebuilds every Word card of the session on each eligibility change (early exit removed on purpose in #1749).
fix: Rebuild only cards whose linked ids changed eligibility.

problem: `apply()` awaits `mineOf(key)` (two userState reads) per pulled record, sequentially, inside merge's turn lock.
fix: Read the page's keys in parallel (reading only page keys is deliberate, so do not list all user state).

problem: Every append calls `change()`, rerunning `derive()` over the whole log.
fix: Update derived state incrementally from the appended record.

problem: `dayOf(date)` filters and sorts all records; the planner calls it per evening slot.
fix: Index records by date once in `derive()`; make `dayOf` a lookup.

problem: Inline pan/tap gesture configs are not memoised, so the worklets are re-sent on every owner render (each keystroke); docs/react-native.md:30.
Unbounded stagger (index × 70 ms): card 30 waits about 2.1 s.
`curve()` builds a bezier function on every render inside worklets.
fix: Build the easings once as module constants (with R72).

problem: Every launch copies the whole bundled SQLite pack (`forceOverwrite`) just to read its version; `replaceWithBundled` copies again.
fix: Ship the bundled content version as config.

problem: Read-only `list`/`record` take the Edition advisory lock + FOR UPDATE and read all 7 record tables for one kind.
fix: Read the one table without locks, as `report()` does.

problem: `serving()` runs per request but calls `switches()`, which also reads minimums and computes `off`.
Feature Switch checked twice where `DEPENDS_ON` already covers it (`account` then `sync`; `communityCounters` then `communityWord`): double DB reads.
`quoteCheckCounts` reads the full `fields` of five tables only to count.
fix: Select ids, versions and `fields->sources->0->url` only (the url is needed).

problem: `dayAfterDays` rebuilds `crosswordSupply` and filters all earlier days per day: O(D²) over about 400 days.
fix: Build the supply once; use a sliding window.

problem: `lemmaIds()` re-reads and re-parses every Entry of the Edition per Synonym Row draft.
Two routes re-implement RailBoard (FlatList + RailScreenCard + hero); `done` recomputes `knownShare`.
fix: Shared code lives in packages/ui: render `RailBoard` with `knownShare`/`shapeAt`, as category-board does.

problem: Same panel, title block, two-button row and StyleSheet three times.
Numbered Definitions copied 4×; the copies already disagree (R10).
Source line and its own `SOURCE_SEPARATOR` copied 4×.
Same answer pop/drop motion; `CELL_POP` equals `VOWEL_POP`.
Verdict header, «Далі» button and styles copied.
Token curve → `Easing.bezier` and the reduce-motion fade config written 4×.
fix: One helper and constant next to tokens/motion in packages/ui.

problem: Submit logic (ref guard, try/catch/finally) copied from CollectionNameField.
Same room/natural scale fit twice.
Back button, safe-area shift and height state copied.
Day label (weekday + month) built 3×.
Hand-rolled `{in: composition}` + `active` read in 5 hooks.
`PlayingLemma` and `useSampleReading` carry the same two effects.
Four hand-rolled walkers of oRPC `error.data` (tools/content with an `as ORPCError` cast) while `SwitchRefusalSchema` exists in contracts (admin.ts:184).
fix: Export refusal schemas from `@slovo/contracts/admin-api` and `safeParse` them in admin and tools/content.

problem: `SecurityWrite`/`useSecurityWrite` duplicate `PendingWrite`/`useQueueWrite` (and have the right Promise shape).
`parseSynonymGroups` and `readSynonymArticles` parse the same «Синонімія» blocks twice.
fix: Keep `readSynonymArticles`; filter by dictionary in source-words.

problem: Four copies of safeParse + `checkNewX` + format + dedupe.
`clamp` and `pop` easing defined in each of 13 files.

where: apps/video/src/FindMistake, SayNicer, OneWord, StopFrame, Missing, Stress, Comeback
problem: Shout `Rings` (4 functions), `Shouter` (6) and Rupor aim maths (4-5) copied across compositions.
Grid model (`sizeOf`, `isBlock`, `answerAt`) is Core logic living in the app; `crossingCells` is O(cells×words×letters) on each render.
fix: Move it to packages/core and index cells once in a Map.

problem: Module has no importer; only commented-out uses remain.
fix: Delete the module and the commented lines.

problem: `tick` stores any number in `seconds` though the schema is `int().nonnegative()`; a bad tick makes the record fail to parse. Latent: the only caller floors and skips ≤ 0.
`tilesOf` never checks the alphabet has enough decoys; a short alphabet or long Word breaks the 4-column row or leaves no decoys.
fix: Leave out such Words or cap tiles at a multiple of 4.

problem: The stop before the Definition depends on whether `read` ends in punctuation, not the `instead` text, so the two run together.
fix: Join label parts with a per-part stop.

problem: `accessibilityRole="header"` inside an `accessible` View is merged away.
fix: Put the role on the accessible View.

problem: The label reads `line` and `refusal`, but only `refusal ?? line` is shown.
Fixed `height` panel; the other posters use `minHeight`.
Empty `items` clamps to -1, so `onIndexChange(-1)`.
Text that becomes empty keeps its old lines.
`isScreenReaderEnabled()` has no `.catch`; a rejection leaves the toast stuck.
Answer tile has no font cap; MissFade ignores Reduce Motion.
A close-by-drag the owner refuses leaves the sheet shifted down.
A save failure goes only to `console.error`.
A rejected `onShare` blocks the button forever.
`key={index}` remounts rows.
An unearned Badge with `current >= target` is drawn as `locked`.
`share` can go negative.
A toggle announces `selected`.
The tile's `accessibilityLabel` is lost.
Empty week and a duplicate `'empty'` key.
fix: Split into weeks, drop empty ones.

problem: Outside VerticalPager the action button does nothing.
fix: Hide the action without the hook.

problem: Counter «12/500» has no words for VoiceOver; `slice` duplicates `maxLength`.
fix: Label from the Edition; keep only `maxLength`.

problem: `parsed as Partial<...>` cast and hand-written JSON parse at the storage edge.
`update` merges onto render-time `current`: two updates in one event lose the first.
The "unforgeable" link key is drawn from `Math.random`.
`canDismiss()` guards `back()`: check and action differ.
`useLocalSearchParams<{x: string}>` unchecked in 7 routes (only correction-type parses).
fix: Parse params once at the route edge.

problem: TOTP accepts ±1 step and never stores the used step: a code is replayable for about 90 s (second factor only).
fix: Keep the last accepted step per Admin; refuse ≤ it.

problem: `invite` sends the email before `addAdminUser`; concurrent invites send two mails, one with the wrong role.
fix: Add the user first, announce after.

problem: Non-HTML `/:edition/c/:id` answers a link of any Edition; the HTML branch refuses it.
fix: Check `link.edition` against the path in both.

problem: Without a bot, `logger.warn({message})` logs the whole Kill switch alert (which may hold the Admin's email).
When a later slot fails, earlier slots stay in the store unsaved; skipped stale Words count as recorded.
fix: Save per slot, or delete puts of failed Words.

problem: Imports files of retired Words too.
The retired check is outside the Edition lock.
`newIssues` caps silently at 100 (one page).
`parseStandardExample` accepts bold marks with edge spaces and adjacent marks with empty text between.
fix: Refuse marks with edge whitespace and empty text between marks.

problem: `unique-lemma` is case-sensitive while `unique-expression` lowercases.
fix: Compare Lemmas in the Edition locale's lower case.

problem: A day with a date gap returns early, so its repeated words show only after the gap is fixed.
fix: Collect the gap error and fall through.

problem: `DaySchema` regex accepts 2026-13-45.
Admin queue/sign-in inputs under /v1 use `z.object`; ADR 0031 says inputs are strict, so typos drop silently.
`new Date()` instead of injected time.
A Patch raises `content_version` but keeps the old metadata `checksum`.
fix: Update or drop the checksum on Patch.

problem: `entryFile` maps any unknown id prefix to `content/corrections`.
No rule against repeated `exceptions.words` or a word equal to `standardForm`.
A third duplicate is reported against the 2nd line, not the first.
Unguarded `localStorage` crashes the root layout when storage is blocked.
fix: try/catch; fall back to the system theme.

problem: Main guard `import.meta.url === file://argv[1]` fails on spaces/symlinks: silent exit 0, every part skipped.
Shake cuts at 21% amplitude (`<12` vs `/14`); `solved=165` may be too early for 8+ letter words (unchecked).
fix: Use one window; derive `solved` from the letter count.

problem: `withStandardFormMarked` bolds punctuation, marks a word when sentences match, and spans unchanged words (ADR 0117).
fix: Compare unstressed words, mark parts, add tests.

problem: `add` with no records opens a batch and exits 0; `edit` ignores a non-numeric `recordVersion`.
PATCH_FORMAT stays 2 though Patches now carry `**` marks and Tip `exceptions`; old builds show raw `**`.
`Object.values(byId).flat()` plus a FitPanel re-render per reported text (O(n²) per size step).
fix: Memoise on `byId` and batch the reports.

problem: `bezierFn` and 5 arrays rebuilt every frame of endless loops.
memo keyed on the Edition object, not on `locale`.
`initialNumToRender` equals all tiles.
Inline `subscribe` to `useSyncExternalStore` resubscribes and re-arms the timer each render.
`useShown()` (32 callers) evaluates all switch checks and returns a new object per render.
`cards` map and filters rebuilt each render, new list `data`.
`days.slice(0, i).filter` per day: O(n²) on every build and checkRecord.
fix: Look back only over the repeat window.

problem: Tip/Synonym Row checks take no `checksFile`, so checkRecord runs them over the whole set per save.
No index on `synonym_row_members.word_id`: full scan on every Word card.
`edition.json` read and parsed up to three times per build.
`entryTexts` re-reads every Entry file per call.
`fakeClock` copied into mobile test-support (without `set`).
fix: Keep it in Core test-support; mobile imports it from `@slovo/core`.

problem: Identical Jest resolvers.
Same fly-in transform worklet.
fix: Export a `flyInStyle` worklet from FlyingText.tsx in packages/ui.

problem: Both `open*Crossword` repeat the ports parameter block and the inline no-XP default.
Cast-based `Object.fromEntries(...) as Record<...>` record builder, copied in mix.ts.
fix: One typed `recordOf(keys, fn)` helper in Core.

problem: `freeze()` and `earn()` share the same 15-line append body.
Same signsIn/cancels/fails/holds/signIn body in both fakes.
Same trace-drag shell; only `hit` differs.
Hand-made button instead of `Button`.
Same halftone pattern twice.
`reopenForSwitches` exists (:76) but :119 and background-sync repeat its reopen + Widget Snapshot body.
Next-local-day timer written twice.
`useCategories`/`useCorrectionCategories` differ only by kind; the two category routes too.
Per-table copies: sweep loops, `saveRecordingRow`/`saveIllustrationRow`, five select blocks.
fix: One helper over a table list.

problem: `snapshotEntries` re-implements `contentSetOf`.
fix: Export `contentSetOf` (with a file-label parameter) from content-rules.

problem: `hasNoRepeats` re-implemented 4×; the "Duplicate id" addIssue loop written 5×.
Content-write reasons repeat `ReasonSchema` without its max(500).
Local `STRESS_MARK` and `ID_PREFIX` restate contracts; "No Word or Correction" check written twice.
`['editions']` query written 5×; analytics/quality queries copied.
Date formatter copied 4× without `timeZone`; blocks/overview use Europe/Kyiv.
`as` casts against the house rule (CLAUDE.md), incl. `as unknown as` in knowledge.ts and test-support.ts.
fix: Typed key lists (`RARITIES`, `ENTRY_KINDS` in Core), type guards, `satisfies`, full fakes.

problem: `for (;;)` retry after an unreadable Entry ends only because card-order ids come from filtered lists; nothing enforces it.
fix: Bound the loop by the number of eligible ids.

problem: `sourceTab`/`tipExceptions` threaded by hand through 3 screens and 3 `SwipedEntryCard` branches.
Two caches for outside reads with different rules (in-flight sharing vs last-good fallback).
Empty-as-unset preprocess repeated; `ownerAlertsOf` parses `process.env` a second time.
fix: One `emptyAsUnset` helper; pass parsed config in.

problem: About 70 lines of commented-out chip/nudge code. Check first whether it is a deliberate DESIGN-05 marker (see dropped P4#29).
fix: Delete if not pending an owner decision.

problem: `relative` / `RelativeText` used only by its test. (Commented DESIGN-05 code nearby is deliberate.)
Unused prop `labelShown` and exports used only in their own file or by tests (`FitPanel`, `MARK_SHARE`, `EntryMenuMarks`, `saveRecording`, `MediaRows`, `MAX_ILLUSTRATION_BYTES` ...).
fix: Remove the prop; drop the exports.
